subject.title: Settings: add unified usage and spend dashboard

question: Should Usage & Spend remain a dedicated persistent Settings destination, or should the same model be integrated into the existing Overview surface that also anchors the sharing action?
rationale: The implementation is substantial and steipete has refined the branch, but neither the discussion nor commits explicitly settle the permanent navigation contract or coordination with the open sharing PR.

options.title: Keep the dedicated pane
options.body: Approve Usage & Spend as its own Settings destination and let the companion sharing PR expose Share Stats from this pane.

options.title: Integrate with Overview
options.body: Move the dashboard model into the existing Overview experience to avoid adding another permanent top-level Settings destination.

options.title: Pause both surfaces
options.body: Hold this PR and the companion sharing PR until a smaller combined information architecture is designed.

recommendation.title: Keep the dedicated pane
recommendation.body: Approve Usage & Spend as its own Settings destination and let the companion sharing PR expose Share Stats from this pane.

likelyOwner.reason: They directly refined the current branch and were explicitly asked to decide the product placement.
